entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 199 aa soluble protein with predicted molecular mass 21.6 kDa and theoretical pI 5.23.
Contains a Ham1p_like domain (Pfam PF01725.22) spanning residues 4–190.
Has 62.2–63.2% identity and 95.5–97.0% query coverage to reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Likely Mg2+-dependent nucleotide pyrophosphatase; exact substrate preference is inferred from homologs rather than directly assayed.

entities.name: Q8XXF4 dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed Ralstonia nicotianae protein; 62.2% identity and 97.0% query coverage to the query.
Annotated as Mg2+-dependent dITP/XTP/ITP pyrophosphatase, EC 3.6.1.66; homodimeric and cytosolic.
Hydrolyzes dITP, XTP, and ITP to the corresponding monophosphate plus diphosphate.

entities.name: Purine NTP quality control
observations: GO:0009146 purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolic process is assigned to close reviewed homologs.
The process removes noncanonical purine triphosphates from the nucleotide pool, reducing their possible incorporation into DNA or RNA.

entities.name: Noncanonical purine NTP hydrolysis
observations: Representative reactions are dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate, XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate, and ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate.
Rhea references reported for homologs: RHEA:28342, RHEA:28610, and RHEA:29399.
